dedupe_keys.name: ifc power markets database structural characteristics of power markets in 50 developing and emerging markets

description: The IFC Power Markets Database presents data on the structural characteristics and development stage of power markets in 50 developing and emerging markets, produced by the International Finance Corporation as part of its flagship report Creating Markets: Power Markets for Development. Over 80 indicators are mapped to five attributes of IFC's AIMM framework: competitiveness, resilience, integration, sustainability and inclusiveness. They cover the number and market share of private players, domestic and cross-border trading arrangements, the structure of electricity networks, tariffs and rates, demand response programmes and policy support for renewables. Data were compiled from secondary sources, including regulator and company annual reports, legal documents, World Bank reports and databases such as S&P Global Market Intelligence, and the page offers a dashboard, the full dataset, country snapshots, a methodology and a reference list for download. Coverage is 50 markets worldwide, updated every two years. Access: free download from the page; no licence is stated and some underlying sources are proprietary. Caveats: compiled from desk research, not utility data. It suits market design and investment context studies, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
